		ai_enabled = { always = no }
		visible = {

		properties = {
			zin_se_picture = {
				image = "[zin_loc_super_event_picture]"

		effects = {
			zin_se_close_click = {
				zin_super_event_close = yes

			zin_se_music_on_click = {
				set_country_flag = zin_se_music_off
				add_to_variable = { zin_se_dirty = 1 }

			zin_se_music_off_click = {
				clr_country_flag = zin_se_music_off
				add_to_variable = { zin_se_dirty = 1 }

			}

		triggers = {

				has_country_flag = zin_se_open

			zin_se_music_on_visible = {
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_se_music_off }
			}
			zin_se_music_off_visible = {
				has_country_flag = zin_se_music_off
			}
			zin_se_queue_visible = {
				check_variable = { zin_se_queue^num > 0 }
